page.title: Card step for Beech cutting board

product.name: Beech cutting board
product.description: The board is beech, edge grain, with a juice groove.

blocks.text: Leather loop is offered at $13.29 and is not ticked, so it stays off the amount due.
Fragile glass leaves the stockroom in a double mailer.
Lane cushion sits outside the tag.
Last week's tag on Beech cutting board was fifty five dollars and sixty one cents. Today's item figure forty six dollars and seventy nine cents matches the tag. That drop is real.

trick.instruction: If you can clear Lane cushion, clear it. If Lane cushion is required and the amount due is over the errand limit, leave without paying.
